description: Defines a structure 'DEG_ID' within the 'slide' namespace for handling degradation models in a simulation framework. Includes nested class 'DegArray' derived from 'SmallVector' to manage model identification arrays, and provides a 'print' method for generating a string representation of degradation settings.

classes.name: slide::DEG_ID
classes.description: Structure for managing degradation model identifiers and configurations.

classes.name: slide::DEG_ID::DegArray
classes.description: Derived from SmallVector, manages arrays of model IDs with an add_model method.

methods.name: add_model
methods.description: Adds a model ID to the DegArray if it is not zero.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Generates a string summarizing the degradation model configuration for use in folder naming.
